title: Rollback must reverse executed mutations only
environment: Tested bone/group merge operations. This is not a guarantee for untested animation state or arbitrary multi-resource transactions.
goal: Recover safely from a failed bone/group merge.
approach: Historical failed assumption: The full planned rename mapping was inverted on failure.
what_worked: Historical correction: Journal actual completed renames and replay that list in reverse; retain original values. Verification reported by the source: Injected failures before the first write and after writes preserved target-only group name and weight. Blender 5.2.1 pose/chain/parenting/identity/rollback/Undo controls and the recorded Python suite passed.
what_failed: Historical observed failure: Rollback renamed an existing target-only group even when the forward phase had never renamed it.
why: Confirmed: the undo plan contained operations that had not executed.
improved_method: Build rollback from executed-operation receipts, not intended operations. Test failure before the first mutation as well as midway through the transaction.
when_to_use: Tested bone/group merge operations. This is not a guarantee for untested animation state or arbitrary multi-resource transactions.
when_not_to_use: This is not a guarantee for untested animation state or arbitrary multi-resource transactions.
known_limitations: This is an independently curated generalization of an earlier recorded failure. No source-side experiment was rerun during this registration; observation_date is the 2026-10-09 knowledge-review date, not the incident date. Applicability and root-cause claims remain limited to the source-reported conditions.
